entry_schema.description: what the hypothesis is and why (written BEFORE looking at validation)

entries.description: H003 (frozen, unchanged) plus an entry-only SPY broad-market regime gate: an H003 raw BUY proceeds to the existing H003/RiskManager path only if the latest completed regular-session 15Min SPY bar has close > EMA50 and EMA50 3-bar slope > 0. SPY is context only (never traded, sized, in P&L or in D6). No new exit; management unchanged.

parameters.base_strategy: frozen H003, unchanged (signal, consumption, re-arm, universe, risk, management, execution)
parameters.context_symbol: SPY (context only; not tradable; excluded from limits, sizing, P&L and D6)
parameters.context_source: Alpaca v2 stock bars, feed=iex, adjustment=raw, 1Min; no silent SIP switch (stop and report if insufficient)
parameters.context_timeframe: 15Min regular-session buckets anchored at 09:30 ET; early close ends 13:00; empty bucket -> no bar; no interpolation
parameters.regime_positive: close_R > EMA50_R and EMA50_R - EMA50_{R-3} > 0 (both strict)
parameters.alignment: R* = latest same-session SPY 15Min bucket with end <= stock decision time D (= signal bar start + 5min); never a partially formed bucket
parameters.missing_context: R* absent -> UNAVAILABLE -> blocked (MARKET_REGIME_UNAVAILABLE); no older-bucket substitution, no fabrication
parameters.gate_placement: after H003 raw BUY, before open-position/halt checks and RiskManager; negative -> MARKET_REGIME_BLOCKED; blocked signals never reach RiskManager
parameters.setup_consumption: H003 setup consumed on raw BUY emission regardless of gate result (pass/blocked/unavailable); H003 re-arm unchanged
parameters.context_indicator_convention: inherit H003 own-window EMA exactly (200 bars ending at each bar, expanding when fewer), including split-boundary behavior; reuse H003 helper; no special seed, no SPY-specific EMA (Q1)
parameters.context_bucket_exists: >= 1 valid regular-session 1Min SPY bar; no minimum count (Q2)
parameters.context_slope_window: R-3 = three existing completed SPY 15Min bars back; may span a missing bucket (Q2)
parameters.context_download_range: support + DEVELOPMENT only (2023-12-01 -> 2025-12-31); validation-range SPY not downloaded/inspected/cached unless dev gates all pass AND implementation frozen AND frozen commit recorded (Q3)
parameters.gate_disabled_mode: tests and pre-run H003 byte-identical reproduction check only; no CLI/public flag; mismatch aborts official H004 development run (Q7)
